paragraphs: Rabbi Yaakov son of Rabbi Chanina. (Tanna of a baraita).

[Shabbat 79b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.79b.4) describes a tannaitic dispute: “If he changed in either case, it is invalid; Rabbi Acha declares it valid in the name of Rabbi Yaakov son of Rabbi Chanina.” In [Sifrei, Haazinu, on “Yaarof,”](https://www.sefaria.org/Sifrei_Devarim.306.21) Hyman has him say to Rabbi: “Come, let us examine the laws, so they do not rust.” In [Avot de-Rabbi Natan, chapter 29](https://www.sefaria.org/Avot_DeRabbi_Natan.29.3), Hyman attributes to him the saying: “One who lies awake at night and does not open his mouth with words of Torah deserves that his mother’s afterbirth should have turned over upon his face.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The checked Shabbat text gives Yaakov son of Rabbi Chanina as an alternative to Achai bar Chanina. Hyman quotes the Yaakov attribution.

The linked Sifrei has Rabbi Yaakov son of Rabbi Chanilai urge Rabbi to review the laws. The linked Avot de-Rabbi Natan gives the nighttime saying to Rabbi Yaakov son of Chananya. Hyman presents both under Rabbi Yaakov son of Rabbi Chanina.
